scope: NCAA Division I plus explicitly labeled Texas State internal data

storage_policy.rule: Deploy one query-optimized canonical pitch-event dataset. Do not place the raw national master or app-local national copies beside it after cutover.
storage_policy.migration_exception: A temporary staging copy is allowed only while its row counts, schema, PitchUID uniqueness, and feature parity are validated.

ncaa_d1_pitch_events_2026.label: 2026 NCAA Division I
ncaa_d1_pitch_events_2026.authority: WallyApps full Division I pitching/hitting export
consumers: BASE team hitting and pitching reports

texas_state_internal_pitch_events.label: Texas State internal and historical
texas_state_internal_pitch_events.authority: Texas State Wally app team exports
scope: 2026 season pitches absent from the national master
rules: Never expose this source as complete NCAA coverage.
Keep internal, scrimmage, and bullpen competition labels distinct.
Prefer the national master when a PitchUID exists in both sources.
Normalize hitting and pitching exports into one event stream instead of retaining app-specific copies.

ncaa_d1_defense_alignment_2026.label: 2026 NCAA Division I defense alignment
rules: Store alignment-only fields plus audit keys; obtain pitch, hitter, contact, and outcome context from ncaa_d1_pitch_events_2026.
Retain unmatched defense rows because 530472 unique defense PitchUID values are not present in the pitch master.

ncaa_d1_catching_2026.label: 2026 NCAA Division I catching
rules: Do not deploy D1 Catching File.parquet as a second national pitch-event copy.
Use catcher, throw, framing, pitch-location, and confidence columns already present in the primary master.
The standalone catching export has 100 percent PitchUID overlap with the primary master.
Called Stuff, xRV, pitch percentile, catcher percentile, and model artifacts remain versioned references, not pitch-event sources.
Each metric must record its population, season, formula version, and generated-at timestamp before production cutover.

pitch_retag_overrides.label: Persistent pitch-type overrides
rules: Key overrides by data source and PitchUID.
Never rewrite or fork the canonical national master to store a retag.
Expose original value, effective value, provenance, saved-at time, and revert behavior in Data Processing.
JUCO aggregate statistics are not NCAA Division I pitch events and must not be unioned into the canonical pitch table.
